product_category.value: Immersive, AI-driven VR (and screen-based) clinical simulation training for healthcare education, covering nursing, medicine and allied health

evidence.quote: OMS delivers immersive, AI-driven VR healthcare training
OMS combines clinical VR training simulations with AI, analytics and hands-on partnership

product_category.note: The first quote is from the homepage META DESCRIPTION line. The platform page headline is 'The VR Platform Built for Real Clinical Readiness'. The site also sells a services layer (implementation, curriculum integration, content co-development) alongside the software.

evidence.quote: Train learners using virtual reality headsets or traditional computer screens
Compatible with both Mac and Windows operating systems
It’s particularly beneficial that candidates can engage with desktop scenarios repeatedly.

platforms.note: Screen-based delivery on Mac and Windows computers is recorded as Desktop. The pages do not say whether the screen version runs in a web browser or as installed software, so Web is not listed. No headset model is named on any page read. The services page offers 'Hardware sourcing, setup and configuration assistance'. The third quote is a customer testimonial.

key_capabilities.note: Other features stated but left out to stay within 10: single-patient or full-caseload scenarios, ED/clinic/home/inpatient environments, built-in comparative analytics, automated rollout with no scheduling. The services page adds non-software offerings: implementation and onboarding, facilitation training, content co-development, and a customer community described as free. The homepage links to 'our analytics engine' but no page describing it was saved.

target_customer.value: Academic institutions (nursing programs, medical schools, allied health programs) and health systems (onboarding and transition to practice for new graduates and recent hires).

evidence.quote: Get nursing students ready for the real world.
OMS supports medical schools as they work with students to close the gap between theory and practice.
OMS partners with allied health programs to bridge the gap between classroom instruction and real-world practice.
OMS partners with your health system to give new graduates and recent hires the experience they need before they reach the bedside.

target_customer.note: Menus also list Physicians Assistant Programs, Quality & Safety, Risk & Compliance and Graduate Medical Education; those pages were not in the snapshot, so they rest on menu labels only. Buyer roles named on the pages include program leadership, deans, simulation directors, faculty, Chief Nursing Officers and nursing professional development leaders. The nursing page tells learners to 'Ask your instructors about bringing OMS to your school.'

value_proposition.value: VR simulation combined with AI, analytics and hands-on partnership that builds learners' clinical readiness, confidence and competence, while giving programs a scalable way to deliver repeatable, consistent training without adding faculty workload.

evidence.quote: OMS combines clinical VR training simulations with AI, analytics and hands-on partnership to ensure your learners build the skills and mindset to meet your clinical reality head-on.

We deliver immersive, flexible simulations that strengthen competence and confidence while giving you a simple, scalable way to offer meaningful, repeatable, consistent training across programs and locations.
Increased training capacity without increasing faculty bandwidth or consuming additional resources

tagline.note: No official tagline found: no line is marked ™, ® or ℠, and no slogan repeats on the pages read. Candidates: homepage headline 'The new ready.' (once); closing banners 'Ready to get real?' (home and company) and 'Redefine readiness with OMS.' (platform and services), which read as calls to action.

pricing.note: No prices, plans or pricing model on the 8 pages read, and no page mentions a quote. Calls to action are 'Get Started', 'Talk to our team' and 'Request a consultation'. The services page says the customer community is 'a free part of your OMS program', which is not a price.
